# openmetadata_messaging_service Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata messaging service by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_messaging_service" "events" {
  fully_qualified_name = "events"
}

output "events_service_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_messaging_service.events.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Messaging service fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Messaging service UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `connection_config` (String, Sensitive) Connector configuration as a JSON object string. Its shape depends on service_type.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Messaging service name.
- `service_type` (String) Connector type, for example CustomMessaging, Kafka or PubSub.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
